# session_cookie — session cookie auth via a login request, pagination.none
# Boots the session_cookie scenario, runs one drain (2 exchanges: POST login,
# GET data), and asserts the trace and events match the golden.
# The spec is loaded live from the embedded template.

exec skopos template show -o spec.yml session_cookie
replace spec.yml http://localhost:9999 $URL
exec skopos run -i spec.yml --once --trace trace.jsonl --out events.jsonl
normalize trace.jsonl
cmp trace.jsonl want_trace.jsonl
cmp events.jsonl want_events.jsonl

-- want_trace.jsonl --
{"elapsed":"<scrubbed>","iteration":1,"method":"POST","request_headers":{"Accept":"application/json, application/x-ndjson;q=0.9, */*;q=0.1"},"response_body":"body 16 bytes, object-like","started_at":"<scrubbed>","status":200,"step_id":"login","url":"$URL_HOST/session_cookie/login"}
{"elapsed":"<scrubbed>","iteration":1,"method":"GET","request_headers":{"Accept":"application/json, application/x-ndjson;q=0.9, */*;q=0.1","Cookie":"<redacted>"},"response_body":"body 347 bytes, object-like","started_at":"<scrubbed>","status":200,"step_id":"data","url":"$URL_HOST/session_cookie/data"}
-- want_events.jsonl --
